trials.title: Study of Carbetocin Nasal Spray for the Treatment of Hyperphagia in Prader-Willi Syndrome

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change from Baseline at Week 12 in caregiver-rated Hyperphagia Questionnaire for Clinical Trials (HQ-CT) score

reasons: one of only 6 trials at this company

signals.text: Primary completion pulled forward 7 months vs original registration (Dec 2023): May 2026 to Oct 2025
signals.read: Enrollment ran ahead of plan. Generally a demand and execution positive.

signals.text: No results posted 12 months after primary completion (Oct 2025)
signals.read: Past the 12-month FDAAA window. Delayed posting skews toward negative or unflattering results.

trials.commentary: Ph 3, randomized, double-blind. Targeting 170 patients. Started Nov 2023, primary completion Oct 2025 vs May 2026 at registration (-7 mo, 2 moves); planned 2.4 yrs, now 1.8 yrs. Recruiting opened Jan 2024, enrollment closed Jun 2025 (17 mo recruiting), completed Aug 2026.
